capabilities: Author basic, reversed, cloze, heading, and reminder cards in Markdown
Create or update matching Anki notes via AnkiConnect and link them back to sources
Sync the current note or the whole vault with include/exclude folder and note rules
Support card callouts, cards in lists, atomic note cards, math, wikilinks, and media
Start Anki automatically when closed and test the AnkiConnect connection
extras: Complete card syntax for callouts, lists, and atomic notes is deferred to an external v2 wiki; legacy v1 documentation lives on a separate branch; the repo includes an optional skill for coding agents.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author flashcards and push them to Anki for spaced-repetition review while keeping notes as the source of content.

relations.evidence: The plugin creates or updates the matching notes in Anki.
Flashcards 2.0.1 and later work with AnkiConnect's default settings.

requires.name: Anki desktop with the AnkiConnect add-on
AnkiConnect API key, if one is configured

summary: Flashcard authoring plugin that creates and updates Anki notes from Markdown cards via AnkiConnect, keeping Obsidian as the source of truth.
